Welcome!

Welcome to this online Escape game about Sci-Fi and Fantasy books !

Instead of searching a room, you will search this blog : “Space Queen Starla’s bookquest” in order to find 5 books to highlight on her special post for the Utopiales.
This escape game is not linear, you have all the informations right at the start which can be overwhelming especially when you’re not sure what you’re looking for.
Don’t hesitate to look at the clues below to help you out as you go along. If there’s a technical problem or you really are stuck you can always “contact a human” and get some help.

  • Cosy Crew
  • Covers and Cartographers
  • Cosmic Quotes
  • Colored Covers
  • Communication and confusion
  • Collecting awards
